docket_entries.description: DECLARATION OF APPEARANCE ON BEHALF OF CORPORATION PURSUANT TO CCP 116.540 (B)-(H) (JULIAN PHILPP, MASTER TENANT) FILED BY DEFENDANT WEST, CHRISTIE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF FEB-10-2022 - CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION TO APR-05-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. COURT DOES NOT ALLOW JULIAN PHILPP (MASTER TENANT) TO APPEAR ON DEFENDANTS'S BEHALF. FINAL CONTINUANCE. NO FURTHER CONTINUANCE IS ALLOWED. DEFENDANT CHRISTIE WEST IS REQUIRED TO APPEAR AT THE NEXT HEARING. IF DEFENDANT IS NOT PRESENT WITHOUT PROPER NOTICE, THE MATTER WILL GO FORWARD WITHOUT HER. PARTIES MAY SUBMIT A REQUEST FOR ZOOM APPEARANCE NO LATER THAN 10 DAYS BEFORE THE NEXT HEARING DATE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED.(506)

ORDER CONTINUED ON THE COURT'S OWN MOTION. FINAL CONTINUANCE. NO FURTHER CONTINUANCE IS ALLOWED. DEFENDANT'S APPEARANCE IS REQUIRED. IF NO APPEARANCE, MATTER WILL GO FORWARD WITH HEARING WITHOUT HER. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)
MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,350.00 FILED BY HOLDER, AMMIEL AS TO DEFENDANT WEST, CHRISTIE ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR JAN-11-2022 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FEE FOR SERVICE: $85.00 SERVED NOV-02-2021, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT WEST, CHRISTIE

SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF JAN-11-2022 - CONTINUED PER REQUEST OF DEFENDANT TO FEB-10-2022 AT 1:30 PM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF AMMIEL HOLDER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHRISTIE WEST IS NOT PRESENT DUE TO CIRCUMSTANCES BEYOND HER CONTROL. JULIAN PHILIPPS, WHO IS A MASTER TENANT FOR DEFENDANT IS PRESENT ON DEFENDANT'S BEHALF TO SEEK A CONTINUANCE. COURT ALLOWS DEFENDANTS REQUEST. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: W. TRUPEK. NOT REPORTED. (506)
ORDER RE: CONTINAUNCE PER DEFENDANT'S REQUEST. (SEE SCANNED DOCUMENT FOR DETAILS)

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF APR-05-2022 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF APR-05-2022 BY MICHELLE TONG. PLAINTIFF AMMIEL HOLDER IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CHRISTIE WEST IS PRESENT WITH WITNESS JULIAN PHILPP. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. PRIOR TO THE HEARING HONORABLE MICHELLE TONG GAVE DISCLOSURE ABOUT CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS MADE. JUDGE: MICHELLE TONG; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED.(D506)
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF APR-05-2022 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF HOLDER, AMMIEL RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT WEST, CHRISTIE $1,800.00 PRINCIPAL, $135.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $1,935.00, SECURITY DEPOSIT $900 AND CIVIL CODE SECTION 1950.5(G) 21 DAY VIOLATION. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
